assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

The session is launched on a non-default model and its first turn must report that model. On 2.x every assistant row carries model.id — the config key, not the provider-side id — and the fold's latest non-empty value is ModelName (parser_v2.go, opencode metrics.go). The launch model comes from the location's config `model`, which an API session at that location picks up.

## The second identity

A second model identity on the one local model: RUN_CWD/opencode.json declares the alias `kolibri-1-4bit-b` under the sandbox's `kolibri` provider, with the SAME API-side id as the default `kolibri-1-4bit` (the Kolibri-1 4-bit path), so irrlicht sees two model names while mlx_lm sees one. Measured before any Kolibri turn, against a local capture stub with only baseURL changed (`/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b1-work/capture/probe-5-2.txt`, `probe-5-3.txt`): all five requests the service sent named exactly that path, and the stored assistant rows carried model.id `kolibri-1-4bit-b` (5-2: the config's launch model) and `kolibri-1-4bit` then `kolibri-1-4bit-b` (5-3: POST /model between the turns).

## Spec choices

The basic-turn arc; observations: model = kolibri-1-4bit-b; a transcript assertion that the step ran on it. ContextWindow is not asserted: the capacity table has no entry for a local model (see 1-8).
caveats: The alias is a config-level identity: the weights are the default model's. That is what the scenario's assertion reads (ModelName = the launch model), and it keeps the shared mlx_lm server on one model.
ContextWindow is 0/unknown for the local model (no capacity entry), as in 1-8.

sources.note: each assistant row's model.id is the step's ModelName; text items feed applyAssistantText (task-estimate scan)
queryV2SessionMetrics re-folds every session_message row in seq order; cumulative tokens/cost come from the session_v2 columns
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
wire probe: the service named the Kolibri path on every request; the stored step's model.id was kolibri-1-4bit-b

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
RUN_CWD/opencode.json declares the alias kolibri-1-4bit-b (same API-side id as the default) and launches the session on it; the shell tool is denied (a no-tool turn)

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok. Do not use any tools.

verify: the turn ends in ready on the plugin's Stop hook
model_name is kolibri-1-4bit-b, not the default kolibri-1-4bit
